description: Complete an endpoint credit top-up after you have obtained a valid signed x402 payment (v2 or v1). Accepts either a dashboard PAT with mcp:endpoints:write or mcp:* or a legacy endpoint API key. If the reply is HTTP 202 with status settlement_pending (or fulfilment_pending / needs_review), the payment may already have gone through: do NOT sign a new payment; call this tool again later with the SAME paymentPayload (pending top-ups are also credited automatically). One payment tops up once: a repeat returns already_applied; reuse for another endpoint returns 409 payment_already_used (nothing charged).

accessToken.description: Your dashboard MCP personal access token (sgl_pat_*). Can be omitted when the connection sends Authorization: Bearer sgl_pat_*

paymentPayload.description: Signed x402 payment from the paying client (v2 relayed as PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, v1 as X-Payment), as JSON or base64 string

slug.description: Slug of the endpoint to top up

name: topup_endpoint_with_payment
